readme: Warning: If you're an AI startup, make sure your data is secure. Exposed prompts or AI models can easily become a target for hackers. Important: Interested in securing your AI systems? Check out ZeroLeaks, a service designed to help startups identify and secure prompt injection and system prompt extraction risks.
